name: Ariadna Gutiérrez
biography: Ariadna María Gutiérrez Arévalo is a Colombian actress and beauty queen who won Miss Colombia 2014 and represented Colombia at Miss Universe 2015 where she placed 1st runner-up. Gutiérrez received international attention due to Miss Universe host Steve Harvey announcing her as the winner by mistake.
